description: This file contains functions and types for parsing CLI profile arguments, resolving profile directories, and applying environment variables related to CLI profiles in the openclaw project.

methods.name: parseCliProfileArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract profile-related options and returns a structured result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: resolveProfileStateDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for a given profile, considering environment variables and home directory.

methods.name: applyCliProfileEnv
methods.description: Sets environment variables based on the specified profile, including profile name, state directory, config path, and gateway port if in dev mode.
